profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Highly skilled Software Engineer at OPEX Corporation, I work on time-critical software that runs on warehouse sorting machines, ensuring their reliability and performance. With a master of science degree in Computer Engneering and a minor in computer science from Drexel University, I have the skills and knowledge to design, develop, and maintain secure and efficient software systems. 

Some of my achievements at OPEX include adding new features, debugging, and upgrading the software that controls the sorting machines, creating software suite manuals, NSIS and InstallShield installers, and designing and maintain APIs for the warehouse automation software stack. I am passionate about solving complex problems, learning new technologies, and enhancing the efficiency and security of software systems. I value teamwork, innovation, and customer satisfaction, and I believe I can bring diverse perspectives and experiences to the team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Add new features, debug, refactor time critical software that runs on Warehouse Sorting machine
- Software internationalization
- Creating software suite manuals
- NSI installers, InstallShield installers
- Design APIs
- Legacy system maintenance

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: - Teach students for the subject Preparation for Engineering Studies, conduct lab, recitation and doubt solving session.

positions.title: Co-op Intern
positions.description:
- Conducted research on cameras equipped with depth sensors for overflow detection. 
-  Implemented color template matching and depth template matching.
- Optimized algorithms for image processing and point cloud calculations, utilizing Nvidia GPUs and CUDA C. 
- Designed a socket program for asynchronous host-device communication over TCP.
positions.insights: Back-End Web Development, C++ and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a 25-member Activation and Testing team in the field of physical layer networking. 
- Diagnosed and resolved connectivity issues, managed real-time network changes, tracked order inventory, conducted testing, and facilitated third-party handovers at rendezvous points. 
- Led team initiatives to enhance communication during client calls and provided training to five professionals to facilitate role transitions.

volunteerExperiences.description: Teaching elementary school children living in outskirts of major cities to fill in unavailability of teachers.
TreePhilly works for Philadelphia parks & recreation, organizes tree giveaway events & tree themed talks. I have been a part of the organization as a volunteer and help in giveaway events.
